title: Source reference
description: Traces one generated statement back to an exact field of an approved synthetic resource. Every generated section requires at least one source reference.

resourceId.description: Must resolve to an entry of the approved synthetic source bundle used for this generation.

fieldPath.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the resource content.

fieldLabel.description: Human-readable label a reviewer can scan quickly.

statementExcerpt.description: Short excerpt of the generated statement this reference supports.
